data.title: 牧濑红莉栖 · 广播会馆天台的世界线风暴
data.description: 秋叶原广播会馆天台铁网旁，阴云翻滚的黄昏天际线。红莉栖双手扶着生锈栏杆极目远眺秋叶原街景，狂风撕扯着酒红高领毛衣与长发，目光充满宿命与决意。
data.location: windswept commercial rooftop overlooking Akihabara urban cityscape at overcast sunset
data.action: gripping rooftop chainlink fence with both hands, long auburn hair whipping wildly across face, gazing into distance with bittersweet resolute purple eyes
data.lighting: 阴云缝隙透下的苍凉暮光与都市反光
data.promptProse: Kurisu grips the rooftop safety fence overlooking Akihabara as strong gusts whip her auburn hair, eyes full of bittersweet resolve beneath dusk clouds.
data.animaCaption: Sunset breaks through storm clouds above the city as wind lashes her hair against the chainlink fence.
